Based on the historical records and contemporary accounts, Pocahontas's 1616–1617 visit to London was explicitly orchestrated by the Virginia Company to serve as a promotional tool for the Jamestown colony. During this time, she was presented to King James I and the royal court, attended a masque at Whitehall Palace, toured the country, and was widely celebrated and documented by English society.
